description: This file defines utilities for handling Linux kernel namespaces in sysctl parameters, including functions to determine the namespace of a sysctl string and extract relevant information.

methods.name: namespaceOf
methods.description: Determines the namespace of a given sysctl value based on predefined mappings.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Extracts namespace information, prefix, and whether the sysctl string is prefixed from a sysctl string.
